rule: **Existing tools work.** Type checkers work through `.d.vibe.ts` (VIP-27), and linters, Knip, bundlers and test runners each read `.vibe`.
errorPattern: consumer types differ from the \.ts twin[\s\S]*=> any
reason: Alchemy's cloudflare-runtime RuntimeServices.ts inferred its Layer's error and requirement channels from core/internal/System.vibe; once System.ts became .vibe, tsdown's declaration pass wrote unknown for both, and the frontend build failed with TS2345. The minimum, a .ts module whose inferred return type is an Effect made by a .vibe module read through a namespace import, declares the whole return type any.
